positions.name: AtlasRehearsalCadenceMandate
positions.frame: how does the monthly Atlas rollback rehearsal requirement move from a stated directive to a settled operating fact?
positions.why: src-1 issues the cadence as a directive from positional authority, backed by an aphoristic maxim equating unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all; src-2 restates the same cadence in flat, matter-of-fact register as an already-settled specification. Read together, the pair traces one directional arc — mandate ratified into standing practice — with no resolution needed between the two since the second simply crystallizes the first.
